raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Busba Kitiyakara’s paternal grandfather was King Chulalongkorn (Rama V), conflating generational relationships. Despite evidence indicating her father (Nakkhatra Mangala Kitiyakara) was the son of Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana (the correct paternal grandfather), the Planner jumped one generation up to Chulalongkorn, who is the great-grandfather. This reflects a genealogical misinterpretation and an overreach beyond the cited evidence.
